defs.def: air that moves quickly as a result of natural forces 风；气流

ex.s: The garden also contains a winding path that guides visitors through the twelve regions of the Silk Road.
ex.t: 园中还有一条蜿蜒的小径，带领游客穿越丝绸之路的十二个地区。

ex.s: Mangroves can help soften waves and protect ____15____(city) from coastal winds.
ex.t: 红树林可以帮助减缓海浪，保护____15__(city)免受沿海风的侵袭。

ex.s: Going to Mount Huangshan reminds me of the popular Beatles' song "The Long and Winding Road". ___56___ is so breathtaking about the experience is the out-of-this-world scenes.
ex.t: 去黄山让我想起披头士那首流行的歌曲《漫长而蜿蜒的路》。这次经历中如此令人屏息的____56____是那些超凡脱俗的景色。

ex.s: It swayed violently in a strong wind

ex.t: 它们最终被送进垃圾填埋场。

ex.s: I took the dogs out four times a day, and I worried that Tilly ______53______ climbing the stairs could reopen the wound.
ex.t: 我每天带狗出去四次，担心Tilly______53______爬楼梯会使伤口裂开。

ex.s: “I was turning the page to get ready for the next page, but the draft wind from the turn caused the spare pages to fall off the stand,” Mr Titterton said, “Luckily I was able to catch them and put them back.”
ex.t: "我在翻页准备下一页时，翻页带起的气流把多余的乐谱从谱架上吹落了，"蒂特顿先生说，"幸好我接住了它们并把它们放回去。"

defs.def: air that you swallow with food or drink; gas that is produced in your stomach or intestines that makes you feel uncomfortable （随食物或饮料）吞下的气；胃气；肠气

ex.s: Beautiful year-round, they invite you to enjoy the smallest detail, from the sound of grasses in the gentle wind to the sculpture of odd-looking seed heads.
ex.t: 它们四季皆美，邀你欣赏最细微的景致，从微风中草叶的沙沙声，到形状奇特的种穗雕塑。

defs.def: breath that you need when you do exercise or blow into a musical instrument （运动或吹奏乐器时的）呼吸

ex.s: Later, when English ships encountered violent storms in the China Sea, Englishmen learned the Cantonese word tai fung, which means “great wind.” The word's ___39___ to touffon is only by chance.
ex.t: 后来，当英国船只在中国海域遭遇猛烈风暴时，英国人学会了粤语词“大风”（tai fung），意思是“大风”。这个词与touffon的___39___只是巧合。

ex.s: Stepping out of jail into the cold wind, Bob, now 58, felt lost and helpless.
ex.t: 鲍勃走出监狱，走进冷风中，如今58岁的他感到迷茫而无助。

defs.def: the group of musical instruments in an orchestra that produce sounds when you blow into them; the musicians who play those instruments （管弦乐团的）管乐器，管乐器组
to make sb unable to breathe easily for a short time 使喘不过气来；使喘大气
to gently hit or rub a baby's back to make it burp (= release gas from its stomach through its mouth) （轻拍婴儿后背）使嗳气

ex.s: She has driven through 55 mph winds in Wyoming, heavy flooding and storms in Alabama and total whiteout conditions in Kansas.
ex.t: 这种漫游癖是从她父亲那里继承的，她说。

ex.s: She would speed up, the wind blowing our hair back _____64_____ my tiny voice singing out, “Weeee-eee-eee!”
ex.t: 她会加快速度，风吹得我们的头发向后飘，而我小小的声音唱着："哇——哦——哦——哦！"

defs.def: to have many bends and twists 路、河等

ex.s: The walls of the houses have a lot of holes in them to allow wind to pass through.
ex.t: 房屋的墙上有许多孔洞，以便风穿过。

defs.def: to wrap or twist sth around itself or sth else 卷缠；缠绕；绕成团
to make a clock or other piece of machinery work by turning a knob, handle, etc. several times; to be able to be made to work in this way 给（钟表等）上发条；（通过转动把手等）操作；可上发条；可通过转动把手（等）操作

ex.s: As the song goes, this long and winding road "will never disappear", and it will always stick in the visitor's memory.
ex.t: 正如歌中所唱，这条漫长而蜿蜒的路“永远不会消失”，它也将永远留在游客的记忆中。

ex.s: Give yourself a test．Which way is the wind blowing?
ex.t: 给自己做个测试。风朝哪个方向吹？

ex.s: And that is why when I wind up my watch, it starts, but when I wind up this passage, it ends.
ex.t: 这就是为什么我给手表上发条时它开始走，而我收束这段文章时它却结束了。

defs.def: to operate a tape, film, etc. so that it moves nearer to its ending or starting position 卷绕，倒（磁带、胶卷等）
to turn a handle several times 转动（把手）
to rest or relax after a period of activity or excitement 人
to go slowly and then stop 机器

ex.s: It stops on the stone floor — and then turns, moving slowly towards a different corner of the cave, where the wind is calmer and the flies more plentiful.
ex.t: 它停在石头地面上——然后转身，缓缓移向洞穴的另一个角落，那里风更平静，苍蝇也更密集。

defs.def: to bring a business, an activity, etc. to an end gradually over a period of time 使（业务、活动等）逐步结束

ex.s: But despite the wind and the rain, I still enjoy working outside in the wild.
ex.t: 但尽管有风有雨，我仍然喜欢在野外工作。

ex.s: And "to wind up a watch" means "to make a watch work", while "to wind up a passage" means "to end a passage".
ex.t: 而且“to wind up a watch”意为“让手表运转”，而“to wind up a passage”意为“结束一段文章”。

defs.def: to make sth such as the window of a car move downwards by turning a handle, pressing a button, etc. 把（汽车窗玻璃等）摇下
to stop running a company, business, etc. and close it completely 关闭（公司、企业等）；（完全）停止营业
to make sth such as the window of a car move upwards by turning a handle, pressing a button, etc. 把（汽车窗玻璃等）摇上
